rationale: Coptic root ⲕⲗⲟⲙ 'wreath, garland'; in this enumerative context (line 19 paired with grape-clusters; line 24 with grains-of-X; line 25 measurable by year) functions as a unit of agricultural produce or vegetative growth. Could also be 'fruits' or 'kernels.' Confidence low.

Small-particle measure noun; paired with ⲛϣⲱ 'sand' in line 26 ('grains of sand') and with ⲕⲗⲏⲗ ⲛ̄ⲕⲁⲍ 'wreaths of earth' in line 24. Functions as the smallest enumerable unit. Possibly related to ⲃⲣⲃⲣ 'pebble' or a reduplicated diminutive.
Compounded ⲙⲁ-(ⲛ-)ⲓⲟⲣⲉ — 'place of rivers' or simply 'rivers' (Lyc. variant). Three cosmic rivers surrounding the cosmos is a standard Manichaean cosmographic feature.
Likely Lyc. variant of ⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ < Greek μέλος 'limb,' with unusual anaptyctic ⲥ. The 'dispersed limbs' would be the scattered light-limbs of cosmic anthropos.
Qualitative form of uncertain root. Context (line 23: 'limbs that are X') suggests either dispersion or honoring. Tentative; awaiting parallels.
Action-noun at start of line 27, possibly related to ⲧⲁϩⲟ 'set, place' or to Greek σκέψις/τάξις. Tentative.
Lycopolitan 3sg perfect of ⲱϩⲉ 'stand' — the great Spirit ⲉⲉϩ ⲍⲏ̄ ⲡⲓⲱⲧ 'stood before the Father.'
Coptic ϩⲁⲧ 'silver' — used metonymically here in triplet with ϣⲓ 'measure' and μέτρον for measuring-instruments.
